# Purple Aurora

Purple Aurora is a dark purple, aurora-inspired interface with minty-blue accents and soft gradients. It adds subtle tag pills, faded fold icons, gradient blockquote borders carrying a large quote symbol, vertical gradient lines for bullets and clearer preview borders, plus tweaks for Calendar and Kanban.

![Purple Aurora screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andreasstandar/Obsidian-Theme---Purple-Aurora/HEAD/1%20Purple%20Aurora%20screenshot.png)
